stable_preferences.nearby_default: Prefer Boston, BU-area, Brookline, Cambridge, and easy nearby trips when event value is otherwise similar.
stable_preferences.distance_rule: Distance is a convenience factor, never a quota or veto.
stable_preferences.destination_exception: A rare annual, culturally significant, visually distinctive, or community-defining event can outrank routine nearby activities.
stable_preferences.known_example: The Revere International Sand Sculpting Festival is the kind of destination-worthy event that should remain visible despite travel distance.
stable_preferences.content_goal: Recommend leisure plans that feel useful, delightful, and realistically plan-able rather than filling a list.
